messages:
sam (platform): Heads-up — we need a small cross-team sync about the new routing/quota metrics for batching dashboards. trying to align on what consumers (console/alerting/infra) actually need.

maria (runtime): +1. which metrics are we thinking? batch size hist, wait time, queue saturation?

sam (platform): Exactly. Draft proposal: `redwood.batch.size` (histogram), `redwood.batch.wait_ms` (histogram), `redwood.queue.saturation` (gauge 0..1). Also label by `model`, `route`, `deployment_zone`, `priority`.

kevin (infra): Sounds good. We should keep cardinality low. `route` and `model` ok, but avoid freeform request_ids. Also suggest `instance_size` instead of deployment_zone for infra-level aggregations.

tara (console): For console panels we want percentiles (p50/p90/p99) + heatmap of batch size distribution. Also growth over time. Can we provide a bucketed histogram for batch sizes (1,2,4,8,16,32)?

maria (runtime): We already emit a raw histogram for request-to-dispatch latency. Adding a consistent batch-size histogram with those buckets is straightforward. Will need SDK change to tag with `priority` label.

sam (platform): Ownership question: runtime emits metrics, infra owns collection/ingest, console owns dashboard UX. Agree?

kevin (infra): Yes. infra will own Prom/OTel scrape config and retention. We should define the metric names + label whitelist in a tiny contract doc so infra doesn't break retention budgets.

maria (runtime): I'll open a small PR to add metric names + buckets. Quick sketch: ```
# metric contract
redwood_batch_size_bucket{le="1",model="gpt-red",route="chat"} 42
redwood_batch_wait_ms_bucket{le="10",priority="high"} 123
redwood_queue_saturation 0.73
```

sam (platform): Nice — note we prefer dots in API docs but underscores in instrumented names are fine for Prom. Let's keep the agreed list in the contract.

tara (console): For dashboards: panels we need
- Batch size histogram (stacked by route)
- Wait time percentiles with SLO overlay (target p99 < 150ms)
- Saturation gauge + alert if > 0.85 for 5m
Could infra add an alert rule template?

kevin (infra): Will add an alert template. Need final label set first. Also need guidance on sampling: if runtime spikes to 20k qps, we can't emit full hist per-request. Propose downsample metrics with `sampler=1/10` label for high-volume routes.

maria (runtime): We can emit sampled metrics but keep counters for totals. Will add `sampled` boolean label and a `sampling_rate` numeric label.

sam (platform): Important: console UX must hide sampled vs unsampled by default, but infra/pg team can toggle. Tara, can console accept `sampling_rate` label and let us show adjusted rate-corrected metrics?

tara (console): Yes, we can apply correction when `sampling_rate` present (new field in panel config). Will add a toggle.

metrics-bot: New PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/runtime/+/2345 — adds `redwood_batch_size` histogram and `redwood_batch_wait_ms` histogram.

maria (runtime): PR ready for review, includes buckets and `priority` label. cc @kevin for sample handling.

kevin (infra): Reviewing today. Can we commit to a rollout window? infra will add scrape rules after PR merges, with a staged retention policy (7d high-res, 30d rolled-up).

sam (platform): Let's aim to merge by EOD Wednesday, infra will enable scrapes Thursday morning, console panels by Friday afternoon. Anyone object?

maria (runtime): Works for me.

tara (console): Fine, I'll stub panels now and wire once infra confirms.

kevin (infra): Fine. I'll also add a short playbook entry for saturation > 0.9: escalate to oncall then fallback routing.

sam (platform): Great — I'll circulate the tiny contract doc in the repo and tag everyone. Thanks :thumbsup:
